title: Gravity raised $30.5M to place ads inside AI chatbots. Its next product targets the bots themselves.
excerpt: Adtech startup Gravity raised $30.5M Series A to place ads in ChatGPT and other AI platforms. It is testing "agent-to-agent" ads that target AI bots, not humans.
content_html:
TL;DR

Gravity raised $30.5M Series A from Lightspeed and Committed Capital. Places ads in ChatGPT and other AI chatbots. Testing agent-to-agent ads that target AI bots. $38.5M total funding. WPP estimates $100B AI ad market by 2030.

Gravity, an adtech startup that places ads inside AI chatbots, raised a $30.5 million Series A co-led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Committed Capital. The round brings total funding to $38.5 million. The company runs a full-stack ad platform: a demand-side platform for buying ads within AI chatbots and agents, a supply-side platform for developers to monetise their AI apps through ads, and an exchange connecting the two. Its advertiser clients include Best Buy, Target, Vercel, and MongoDB.

The startup places text-based ads inside ChatGPT and several other AI assistants, including Codebuff, EcoGPT, Daimon, Magneta, Runable, and CTO.new. OpenAI shifted ChatGPT’s ad model to cost-per-click in April and is building its own ad platform with partners like Adobe, StackAdapt, and Criteo. Gravity is betting it can carve out a position by owning the full stack and working across multiple AI platforms rather than being locked to one.

The more provocative product is agent-to-agent advertising, which human users never see. Advertisers provide Gravity with their product catalogue, including features and current promotions. When an AI shopping agent searches for a category, it receives a list of all relevant advertisers with detailed descriptions. “It helps enrich the buying decision,” cofounder Zach Oldham told Business Insider. Gravity plans to integrate direct payment so an agent can complete a purchase once a user approves.

The market projection is enormous. WPP Media estimates marketers will spend $100 billion on ads within generative AI search globally by 2030. OpenAI alone forecasts its ad business will hit $100 billion by the same year. Oldham thinks even that is conservative. ChatGPT introduced ads in February and crossed $100 million in annualised ad revenue within two months. The question for Gravity is whether a small independent platform can build real network effects in a market where Google already runs the world’s biggest ad business and OpenAI is building its own. Oldham’s answer is that owning both sides of the transaction, buyer and seller, makes the network smarter with every placement.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Gravity 从 Lightspeed 和 Commited Capital 筹集了 3050 万美元的 A 轮融资。 在 ChatGPT 和其他 AI 聊天机器人中放置广告。 测试针对 AI 机器人的代理间广告。总资金 3850 万美元。 WPP 预计到 2030 年人工智能广告市场将达到 1000 亿美元。

Gravity 是一家在人工智能聊天机器人中放置广告的广告技术初创公司，筹集了 3050 万美元的 A 轮融资，由 Lightspeed Venture Partners 和 Commited Capital 共同领投。 此轮融资总额达到 3850 万美元。 该公司运营着一个全栈广告平台：一个用于在人工智能聊天机器人和代理中购买广告的需求方平台，一个供开发人员通过广告将其人工智能应用程序货币化的供应方平台，以及一个连接两者的交易所。 其广告客户包括 Best Buy、Target、Vercel 和 MongoDB。

该初创公司在 ChatGPT 和其他几个人工智能助手中放置了基于文本的广告，包括 Codebuff、EcoGPT、Daimon、Magneta、Runable 和 CTO.new。 OpenAI 在 4 月份将 ChatGPT 的广告模式转变为按点击付费，并正在与 Adob​​e、StackAdapt 和 Criteo 等合作伙伴构建自己的广告平台。 Gravity 认为，它可以通过拥有完整的堆栈并在多个人工智能平台上工作而不是局限于一个平台来占据一席之地。

更具挑衅性的产品是代理商对代理商的广告，这是人类用户永远看不到的。 广告商向 Gravity 提供其产品目录，包括功能和当前促销活动。 当人工智能购物代理搜索某个类别时，它会收到所有相关广告商的列表以及详细说明。 “它有助于丰富购买决策，”联合创始人扎克·奥尔德姆告诉《商业内幕》。 Gravity 计划整合直接支付功能，以便代理商在用户批准后即可完成购买。

市场预测是巨大的。 WPP Media 估计，到 2030 年，全球营销人员将在生成式人工智能搜索广告上花费 1000 亿美元。 仅 OpenAI 就预测其广告业务到同年将达到 1000 亿美元。 奥尔德姆认为即使这样也是保守的。 ChatGPT 在 2 月份推出了广告，两个月内年化广告收入就突破了 1 亿美元。 Gravity 面临的问题是，一个小型独立平台能否在谷歌已经运营着全球最大广告业务、OpenAI 正在建立自己的广告业务的市场中建立真正的网络效应。 奥尔德姆的答案是，拥有交易双方（买方和卖方），可以使网络在每次投放时变得更加智能。
